question: Commission President Ursula von der Leyen has announced plans for a defence commissioner post in the next Commission. 1.
Is an additional commissioner post to be created or will the defence portfolio be taken on by one of the existing 27 Commissioners?
Does the Commission intend to change the Treaties in order to secure greater defence powers for the Union?
Precisely what responsibilities would fall to a commissioner for defence? Would their remit include active offensive operations?
answer: 1. and 3. Pursuant to Article 17(6) of the Treaty on the European Union, the President of the Commission is responsible for the internal organisation of the Commission. It will be for the future President-elect to decide on the allocation of portfolios to the candidate Commissioners. 2.
The Commission has not submitted to the Council of the European Union any proposals to amend the Treaties.
